parameters.query:
SELECT json_build_object(
  'totals', (SELECT json_build_object(
    'count_total', count(*),
    'count_pending', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='pending_review'),
    'count_approved_unpaid', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='approved' AND paid_at IS NULL),
    'count_paid', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='paid'),
    'count_disputed', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='disputed'),
    'amount_pending', round(coalesce(sum(total_amount) FILTER (WHERE status='pending_review'), 0)::numeric, 2),
    'amount_approved_unpaid', round(coalesce(sum(total_amount) FILTER (WHERE status='approved' AND paid_at IS NULL), 0)::numeric, 2),
    'amount_paid_30d', round(coalesce(sum(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE paid_at > now() - INTERVAL '30 days'), 0)::numeric, 2)
  ) FROM invoices),
  'by_category', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.amount_pending DESC) FROM (
    SELECT category, count(*)::int AS pending_count,
      round(coalesce(sum(total_amount), 0)::numeric, 2) AS amount_pending
    FROM invoices WHERE status='pending_review' AND category IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY category
  ) t), '[]'::json),
  'by_trade', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.total_count DESC) FROM (
    SELECT trade_type,
      count(*)::int AS total_count,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='pending_review')::int AS pending,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='paid')::int AS paid,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='disputed')::int AS disputed,
      round(coalesce(avg(total_amount), 0)::numeric, 2) AS avg_amount
    FROM invoices WHERE trade_type IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY trade_type
  ) t), '[]'::json),
  'recent_pending', coalesce((SELECT json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.created_at ASC) FROM (
    SELECT i.id::text AS invoice_id, i.supplier_name, i.invoice_number, i.invoice_date,
      i.total_amount, i.category, i.trade_type, i.created_at,
      floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - i.created_at))/86400)::int AS days_waiting,
      p.id::text AS project_id, p.name AS project_name
    FROM invoices i JOIN projects p ON p.id = i.project_id
    WHERE i.status='pending_review'
    ORDER BY i.created_at ASC LIMIT 20
  ) t), '[]'::json)
) AS report;
